newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: KLI tops actives with over 5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: KLI tops actives with over 5 mln shares.

text.p: Malaysia's investment holding firm KLI Holdings topped the actives list in the Stock Exchange of Singapore on Monday with over five million shares traded.
At 0155 GMT, KLI saw 5.0 million shares traded. Dealers said no block deals were involved.
The shares also hit a year high of S$2.37. The previous year high was at S$2.24.
Dealers said they were unaware of any corporate news that could have fuelled the rally.

"The Malaysian stocks have been rallying the past few days. There could be a mix of factors including a play in most of the shares traded over the counter (OTC)," said a dealer with a local institution.
"CLOB (OTC market) has been dead for quite some time now. This could be pent-up demand," said another dealer.
Dealers also said there could be arbitraging activities as the stock listed in the Kuala Lumpur exchange was trading at a higher price than in Singapore.
